name: vix_bucket_strategy_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: India VIX is constructed from NIFTY option implied volatilities and reflects institutional hedging demand in real time. In Calm regimes (VIX < 13), NIFTY's tight intraday range means market makers aggressively fade 3-minute Bollinger Band excursions — they are collecting spread in low-vol, and any 10-15 spot point deviation from VWAP is absorbed within 30-60 seconds. In Normal regimes (VIX 13-18), large TWAP algorithms run directional orders lasting minutes; an EMA(9-min) crossing above EMA(21-min) on NIFTY signals a fresh wave of institutional buying that typically sustains for 45-90 seconds. In Elevated regimes (VIX 18-24), delta-hedging by options dealers creates self-reinforcing momentum: dealers short gamma who hedge must buy rising and sell falling NIFTY, extending Supertrend-confirmed directional moves for 60-120 seconds. Crisis regimes (VIX > 24) are excluded as two-way flow becomes unpredictable.

indicators.name: vix_bucket
indicators.formula: CALM if VIX < 13; NORMAL if 13 <= VIX < 18; ELEVATED if 18 <= VIX < 24; CRISIS if VIX >= 24
indicators.purpose: Real-time VIX level from vix_df is the primary regime switch. No lookback needed — the current level is the signal. India VIX is a 30-day forward vol forecast, not a lagging indicator.

indicators.name: bb_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute Bollinger Bands (36 bars × 5s) for Calm regime mean-reversion. Original used 15-bar 1-min BB = 15 minutes; we compress to 3 minutes because at 5-second resolution we trade the FAST reversion (30-60s), not the slow drift back over 15 minutes. Market makers fade Calm-regime deviations within seconds, so a longer window misses the entry timing.

indicators.name: rsi_24
indicators.purpose: 2-minute RSI (24 bars × 5s) to confirm exhaustion in Calm regime. Original used RSI(10) on 1-min = 10-minute RSI. Compressed to 2 minutes (24 bars) because in calm conditions, short-term selling exhaustion shows up within 2 minutes; a 10-minute RSI is too slow to detect the fast bounce we are trading.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.purpose: Cumulative daily VWAP as directional context filter across all regimes. No period scaling needed — VWAP is cumulative from market open regardless of bar size. Acts as the fairness anchor: deviations below VWAP in Calm support CE buys, deviations above support PE buys.

indicators.name: ema_108
indicators.purpose: 9-minute fast EMA (108 bars × 5s) for Normal regime crossover. Original used EMA(9) on 1-min = 9 minutes. Same calendar time is correct because institutional TWAP momentum plays last for minutes, not seconds — the 9-minute EMA captures the same order flow persistence as the original, just at higher resolution.

indicators.name: ema_252
indicators.purpose: 21-minute slow EMA (252 bars × 5s) for Normal regime crossover anchor. Original used EMA(21) on 1-min = 21 minutes. Same calendar time preserves the 9/21 crossover characteristic — the slow EMA represents the dominant intraday trend backdrop that institutional orders must clear before the fast EMA crossover is meaningful.

indicators.name: supertrend_120_2.5
indicators.purpose: 10-minute Supertrend (120 bars × 5s) for Elevated regime trend-following. Original used ATR(10) on 1-min = 10 minutes. Same ATR time window, but multiplier reduced from 4.0 to 2.5 because at 5-second resolution the true range per bar is much smaller — a 4.0 multiplier on 5s ATR would produce bands so wide they never flip direction. 2.5 at 5s is approximately equivalent sensitivity to 4.0 at 1-min.

conditions: CALM: close < BB_lower_36 AND close < VWAP AND RSI(24) < rsi_oversold AND close > close[-1] (uptick confirmation)
NORMAL: EMA(108) crosses above EMA(252) AND close > VWAP
ELEVATED: Supertrend(120, 2.5) is bullish AND close > VWAP AND volume > 1.5 * SMA(volume, 20)
buy_ce.confirmation: Single-bar uptick for CALM; crossover bar for NORMAL; Supertrend flip bar + volume for ELEVATED

conditions: CALM: close > BB_upper_36 AND close > VWAP AND RSI(24) > rsi_overbought AND close < close[-1] (downtick confirmation)
NORMAL: EMA(108) crosses below EMA(252) AND close < VWAP
ELEVATED: Supertrend(120, 2.5) is bearish AND close < VWAP AND volume > 1.5 * SMA(volume, 20)
buy_pe.confirmation: Single-bar downtick for CALM; crossover bar for NORMAL; Supertrend flip bar + volume for ELEVATED

exit.stop_rationale: Calm: 3 pts — NIFTY moves 1-3 option pts in 30s in calm conditions; if we lose 3 pts on a mean-reversion trade, the BB deviation is deepening rather than reverting. Normal: 4 pts — EMA crossover momentum should not retrace more than 8 spot pts (4 option pts at delta 0.5) within 60s if the institutional flow is genuine. Elevated: 6 pts — elevated vol causes 12-15 spot pt whipsaws; need room before confirming trend failure.
exit.target_rationale: Calm: 4 pts — successful BB bounce captures 8-10 spot pts at delta 0.5; targeting conservative 4 pts (1:1.33 R:R at tight stop). Normal: 6 pts — EMA crossover momentum extends 12-15 spot pts post-crossover on NIFTY; capturing 60% of typical move (1:1.5 R:R). Elevated: 9 pts — VIX 18-24 momentum moves extend 18-25 spot pts via dealer delta-hedging; targeting 45% of expected move (1:1.5 R:R).

filters.vix_filter: Primary regime gate: CRISIS (VIX >= 24) suppresses all signals; each regime activates its own sub-strategy
filters.time_filter: No entries before 09:25 IST (565 min) — opening 10 minutes have erratic VIX readings; no entries after 15:10 IST (910 min)
filters.volume_filter: ELEVATED only: volume > 1.5x 20-bar rolling average confirms institutional participation behind trend
filters.trend_filter: VWAP acts as universal trend filter across all regimes — buy CE only below VWAP in Calm, above VWAP in Normal/Elevated
filters.spread_filter: N/A — limit order execution, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — VIX bucket thresholds (13, 18, 24) may drift as structural vol changes. EMA crossover signals in Normal regime are rare events (2-4/day) which limits overfitting but also reduces daily P&L consistency.

adaptation_notes: Three major changes from original: (1) BB lookback compressed 15-min→3-min to trade the fast 30-60s reversion rather than slow 15-min drift; (2) Supertrend multiplier reduced 4.0→2.5 because 5-second ATR is much smaller than 1-minute ATR — same sensitivity requires a smaller multiplier; (3) Volume threshold reduced to 1.5x (from 2x) for elevated regime because 5-second volume is noisier and 2x would filter too many valid trend bars. EMA periods kept at same calendar time (9-min/21-min) because institutional momentum thesis operates on clock time not bar count.
weaknesses: EMA(9-min)/EMA(21-min) crossovers on NIFTY happen only 3-6 times per day in Normal regime — very low trade frequency means high sensitivity to individual trade outcomes
VIX bucket can oscillate near thresholds (e.g., 17.8-18.2) causing rapid regime switches mid-trade, invalidating the sub-strategy thesis
Supertrend in Elevated regime may lag fast NIFTY reversals; entering on a Supertrend flip at 5s resolution means 10-minute momentum may already be exhausted

_source.original_hold_time: CALM: 10-20 min; NORMAL: 20-45 min; ELEVATED: 30-90 min
_source.original_stop: CALM: 12 bps; NORMAL: 20 bps; ELEVATED: 35 bps
_source.original_target: CALM: 20 bps; NORMAL: 35 bps; ELEVATED: 60 bps
